translations.web: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
translations.bsb: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
translations.kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
